articles.title: GovernGPT (YC W24) Is Hiring Engineers to Build Thinking Systems in Montreal
articles.originalTitle: GovernGPT (YC W24) Is Hiring Engineers to Build Thinking Systems in Montreal
articles.excerpt:
About the Team

We’re a YC-backed, profitable startup that’s building agents to automate the most manual, critical function of managing
multi-billion dollar investments - fundraising. Every day, Tier 1 funds rely on our product to close new and update
existing investors.

We build with the newest tools. Every role within our tight-knit, all-engineers team has incredible autonomy to go out
and delight our users. If you want to go all in on coding agents, build knowledge graphs, or explore novel async ways of
ingesting data at scale, you can do that here - everything we do is innovative at its core.

This is just the start, we have much bigger plays planned in partnership with our customers to change how trillions of
dollars of private capital is allocated in global financial markets.

About the Role

Our users rely on reasoning systems enabled in large part by a metadata-enriched database and scalable backend, to trust
the decisions AI makes to automate real work. Of the 3 pillars we prioritize in our technical org for realizing agents
(reasoning, database, and interface), you will work directly with the CTO to own the database. That means building
autonomous systems to enrich data, serve it securely and efficiently, while collaborating with the ICs responsible for
reasoning and interface.

This is fundamentally a high-trust environment where we function as a cohesive innovation unit to build at the bleeding
edge of what’s possible with LLMs. Your fit must be technical as much as cultural.

In this role, you will:

  - Architect backend services for scalable and reliable pre-processing of documents to be consumed by reasoning systems
    for more stochastic outputs.
  - Own the design and delivery of novel data models to enable advanced reasoning.
  - Maintain interfaces that are optimized to be utilized by coding agents and designers of other service layers
    (interface and reasoning).
  - Be responsible for the reliability of services in production and work directly via our PaaS layer on Kubernetes to
    manage zero downtime deployments.
  - Contribute to all of our automated infrastructure that supercharges us to build more via coding agents, automated
    preview environments, testing, etc.
  - Develop patterns for agents to operate safely under constraints in secure environments.
  - Adapt your role to focus on the aspects you like the most as our team scales.
  - Work directly with a team of cross-disciplinary, A-player technologists who will give you the biggest challenge of
    your career.

You are:

  - Passionate about what you do, you’ve paved your own path and aren’t averse to making unconventional career moves.
  - Experienced with seeing systems go to production, break, and fix.
  - Self-guided in your exploration and can lead like an independent contributor.
  - A team player where you like to own your own competencies but you know the output of a great group is more than just
    additive.
  - Eager to learn, grow, and adopt the newest tools as the discipline of engineering fundamentally changes.
  - Looking for a team that gives you more than your typical job.

How to Stand Out:

Write us about your unique skills and passions, how you like to work, what you believe about the future, a time you took
a big bet on yourself, or anything else you think might help you stand out as a first principles, independent thinker.
Less is more, we’re only looking for exceptional team fit.

Stack

  - Python/FastAPI
  - Postgres
  - Kubernetes on AWS
  - LLMs
  - Coding Agents

This role is exclusively based in our Old Port Montreal office. We all have a few hours of overlap per day in person.
It’s how we collaborate, build culture and make sure we’re having fun.

You’ll vest meaningful equity as part of your compensation.

articles.title: ZAYA1-8B: An 8B Moe Model with 760M Active Params Matching DeepSeek-R1 on Math
articles.originalTitle: ZAYA1-8B: An 8B Moe Model with 760M Active Params Matching DeepSeek-R1 on Math
articles.excerpt: Who should care If you work with math, science problems, or complex coding tasks and you're looking for something small enough to run locally or cheaply via API, this is worth serious evaluation. The benchmark numbers at 760M active parameters are not normal and the Markovian RSA boost means performance scales with compute budget rather than hitting a fixed ceiling. If you're building agent workflows that need reliable tool calling or multi-step instruction following, look elsewhere for now. The agentic numbers are honest about that gap. Researchers working on test-time compute methods will find the Markovian RSA implementation worth studying regardless of whether they deploy the model itself. The co-design approach — training the model specifically to work with the inference method rather than applying the method after the fact — is an interesting direction that most labs haven't published on at this level of detail. The AMD training story is also worth paying attention to if you care about where the hardware ecosystem goes next. This is the most capable model trained end to end on AMD hardware that anyone has published. That matters beyond just this one release.

articles.originalTitle: ​Pożar w Puszczy Solskiej. "Kolejna doba może być kluczowa"
articles.excerpt: "Po nocnych działaniach, które były bardzo intensywnie prowadzone, mamy sytuację opanowaną. Nie oznacza to, że się nie pogorszy" - mówił w Rozmowie o 7:00 w Radiu RMF24 Wiesław Leśniakiewicz - wiceszef resortu spraw wewnętrznych i administracji, pytany o pożar w Puszczy Solskiej na Lubelszczyźnie. Zwracał uwagę, że prognozowany jest porywisty wiatr, który może doprowadzić do rozprzestrzeniania się pożaru. Pytany o siły zaangażowane w gaszenie pożaru Leśniakiewicz wspomniał o ponad 600 zaangażowanych osobach - wśród nich jest ponad 300 zawodowych strażaków i prawie 140 ochotników.
